name: smwmusic-waterworld-diving
title: Waterworld - Diving
description:
This is Dean Evan's masterpiece and in my opinion one of the best songs on the SNES catalog.
It would best fit in water levels, especially long ones, but it can also be used for a variety of other themes.

Special thanks to Sinc-X and Maxodex for pointing out the errors present in the early C3 version! This was definitely hard to remake but I'm happy with how it turned out.

Update: now the default SFX channel used is 8, which is recommended for water levels. If you want to use the song in a non-water level, change "WATER_LEVEL" to 0 at the top of the file.
